description: PFAS results for one water system by PWSID from EPA's UCMR5 occurrence monitoring (2023-2025): whether the system was sampled, which of the 29 PFAS (plus lithium) were detected, detection counts, and maximum and mean detected concentrations in µg/L and ppt, with the 2024 PFAS MCLs shown as reference context. UCMR5 sampled only a subset of systems; no results means the system was not sampled under UCMR5, not that its water is PFAS-free. UCMR5 is occurrence monitoring, not compliance monitoring, so results are not compliance verdicts. Use this for one known system; use list_systems_with_pfas_detections instead to find or rank systems with detections across a state, county, or single analyte.

pwsid.description: Public Water System ID, e.g. IL0970450

name: get_system_pfas
